page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes on the right (Scripture references, numbered 4 and 5 and marked with letters). Running head at top above the text with page number at top right. Below the text, a new heading "GOMARVS." followed by a paragraph beginning with a large initial Q.

main_text.p: quod capite sequenti dicitur? Quid facient qui baptizantur pro mortuis? varios habet sensus. Rursus ex profunditate rei ipsius coelestis & altitudine doctrinæ, quam mens imbecillis attingere nequit. Quis quæso intelligit, quod ad Ephesios scribitur; Vt innotescat principibus & potestatibus in cælestibus, per ecclesiam multiformis sapientia Dei, secundum præfinitionem seculorum quam fecit in Christo Iesu Domino nostro. Et postea; Vt possitis comprehendere cum omnibus sanctis, quæ sit latitudo & longitudo & sublimitas & profundum. Denique ex mysterijs, quæ similitudinibus explicantur, quæ res facit, ut tota Apocalypsis B.Iohannis inexplicabili obscuritate lateat inuoluta.1.Cor. 15.29.Ephes. 3.10.Ephes. 3.18.
main_text.head: GOMARVS.
main_text.p: QVÆNAM hæc inconstantia est, Coftere? amphora coepit institui, currente rota cur vrceus exit? Quæstionem de Sacrarum literarum lectione prælegis, ac subito, quasi tui oblitus, ad earum interpretationem desultas. Quæ fane longe alia quæstio est: ac praeterea distincte explicari solet. Verum tamen5.

page.notes: Marginal reference 4 is printed beside the first paragraph; the damaged text near "prælegis / lectione" and "praeterea distincte" is doubtful. The text of the last line is partly obscured by a fold and the Gomarus line is uncertain.
